item.title: Episode 1: A Brand-New Cat, Five Brave Cheetahs, and a Comet from Another Star
item.description:
Maya and Leo zoom around the planet: a new wild cat species in Bolivia, baby capybaras, giraffes and gharials, brave cheetah cubs in Prague, an interstellar comet, space computers, and festivals in Scotland and the Seychelles.

item.title: Episode 2: A Baby Rhino, Tiny Tiger Cubs, and a Giant Moon Crater
item.description:
Maya and Leo travel from Thailand to Greece to the Moon: a baby white rhino born on World Rhino Day, three rare Sumatran tiger cubs, the biggest new moon crater ever found, and October festivals around the world.

item.description:
Maya and Leo go deep underground to find out why volcanoes erupt: magma chambers, shaken-soda-bottle pressure, tectonic plates, Mount St. Helens, lava on Mars, and a fizzy kitchen experiment.
